company.title: Empowering Alaska's Fishing Industry
company.subtitle: We're building the future of fishery intelligence with real-time data, AI-powered insights, and a deep commitment to Alaska's fishing community.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text1: To revolutionize Alaska's fishing industry by providing accessible, real-time fishery intelligence that empowers fishermen, fleet operators, and industry professionals to make informed decisions on the water.
mission.text2: We believe that data-driven insights should be available to everyone in the fishing community, from independent fishermen to large commercial operations. Our platform democratizes access to critical information that was once only available to a select few.

story.title: Our Story
story.text1: SeaScope was born from a simple observation: Alaska's fishing industry needed better tools to navigate an increasingly complex and data-driven world. Founded in 2024 by a team of technologists and fishing industry veterans, we set out to build a platform that would level the playing field.
story.text2: What started as a basic mapping tool has evolved into Alaska's most comprehensive fishery intelligence platform. Today, we serve thousands of users across all major fishing regions, from Bristol Bay to Southeast Alaska, providing real-time data, AI-powered predictions, and actionable insights that help our users succeed.
story.text3: We're proud to be Alaska-based and deeply connected to the communities we serve. Our team includes former fishermen, marine biologists, data scientists, and software engineers—all united by a passion for supporting Alaska's fishing industry.
